_readme: Single hardware anchor for paper-facing results.
Every entry carries an explicit source tag; only meth_main / meth_si / bazavan_pra107
may back a paper-facing quantitative claim. Entries tagged 'assumed' must appear only
as internal cross-check inputs (never quoted as a Meth number).
Provenance schema: {value, unit, source, cite, reason?}.
cite   ::= 'page N', 'Table SX', 'Ext. Data Fig. N panel', 'Eq. (X)'
RQC/Yb+ numbers dropped from this file (previously in v5 handoff, internal only).

_conflict_resolution.primary_derivation: (d-1) detection events x 1 ms fluorescence + (d-2) inter-event re-cooling x (2 ms Doppler + 0.5 ms PGC) = (d-1)*1 + (d-2)*2.5 = (d-2)*3.5 + 1  ms.  Re-cooling is skipped after the last detection, which is why the (d-2) coefficient carries the re-cooling and the (d-1) carries the fluorescence.
_conflict_resolution.secondary_source: meth_si Note II, page 3 (rounded value inside a tradeoff sentence, not a measurement)
_conflict_resolution.secondary_use: table_SIII_reproduction_only â€” invoke ONLY inside a validation script that reproduces SI Table SIII from its own rounded inputs; NEVER cite in a paper-facing runtime claim.

qudit_entangling_gate_time_ms.reason: SI never quotes a per-gate qudit entangling duration. Runtime cross-check uses only the total readout formula + Table SIII ratio.

duration_reporting_rule.rule: Report T in units of 1/(eta*Omega) (or 1/Omega for carrier-only gates) wherever the gate time scales that way, and give the ms value only as an illustration at the stated Omega.
duration_reporting_rule.why: sideband_omega_max_over_2pi_kHz (8 kHz) and carrier_omega_max_over_2pi_kHz (100 kHz) are 'assumed' fields (see hardware_bounds_NOT_in_meth). Every gate duration in absolute ms therefore inherits that assumption. Report a duration in Omega-invariant form and no paper claim rests on those assumed Omega values.
applies_to: QT, QCD, QCR, QT-SB sideband-driven blocks (T ~ 1/(eta*Omega))
duration_reporting_rule.runtime_ratio_note: The qudit/qubit runtime RATIO is Omega-independent when both encodings run on the same drive. Absolute qudit-encoding ms and absolute qubit-encoding ms both scale by 1/Omega, so their ratio is invariant. State this explicitly in the runtime section.

relative_runtime_meth_table_SIII._note: 'One execution' RELATIVE runtime, calculated for the device used in the main text.

sdf_recipe._purpose: Basis for QCD conditioning and QCR/QT-SB pulse construction.

coherence_budget_paper_facing._rule: Any single-pulse duration must satisfy T_pulse << motional_coherence_tau and T_pulse << T2_optical.

heating_budget_phonons_per_pulse.cite: heating rate 2.7/s times 5 ms envelope (Meth typical)

hardware_bounds_NOT_in_meth._note: These parameters are NOT quoted in Meth main+SI. Used only as internal cross-check inputs, never as paper-facing headline numbers.

carrier_omega_max_over_2pi_kHz.reason: Consistent with Bazavan-class Ca+ trap. Rejects any pulse whose Omega_peak/2pi > 100 kHz.

sideband_omega_max_over_2pi_kHz.reason: Demonstrated BSB Rabi is 4 kHz (Meth, SIDEBAND rate = η·Ω_carrier). Allow 2× headroom (8 kHz sideband) before flagging saturation. NOT a carrier Rabi bound.

detuning_range_over_2pi_MHz.reason: Bounded by (i) staying below 2 * Ï‰_z = 1.54 MHz to keep single-mode picture, (ii) not sweeping across other Zeeman transitions ~few MHz away (Meth SI Note IVa).

awg_sample_rate_MSa_per_s.reason: Standard AWG for ion-trap control; sub-kHz slew is trivial at this rate.

rise_fall_ns.reason: AOM rise time typical of this class of experiment.

internal_cross_check_only_do_NOT_quote._note: RQC/Yb+ numbers previously carried in handoff v5. Retained here only as internal sanity ratio; MUST NOT appear in paper-facing tables.

software_frame_updates.observation: Meth compensates spectator AC-Stark shifts in software via a per-state phase register with frame updates on subsequent operations.
sources: Meth Methods p.8 ("compensated for in software by frame updates on subsequent operations")
Meth SI Note IVa (encoding chosen to make spectator shifts static, easily compensated by software frame updates)
software_frame_updates.implication: Frame-update / virtual-Z is native, calibrated, and used on-line on this hardware. This is INDEPENDENT support that QPS (= virtual-Z on the addressed level) commits zero physical time on both encodings, per the QPS README.

sideband_rabi_interpretation.evidence: Meth Methods p.8 quotes "AC Stark shifts on spectator levels for an excitation of the blue sideband of the S-1/2<->D-1/2 transition ... with a Rabi frequency 2π×4 kHz". The Rabi frequency IS the sideband Rabi (i.e., already η·Ω_carrier), not the carrier Rabi.

per_pulse_hardware_overhead.search_result: No per-pulse dead time, AWG/AOM switching time, or inter-pulse sequence overhead is quoted in Meth main+SI or Ringbauer 2022. Only individual pulse durations (t_pi, gate times) and total sequence times (readout, cooling) appear.
per_pulse_hardware_overhead.implication: Absolute headline durations at the sub-microsecond level are NOT MEANINGFUL without this figure. Report sub-us times only as internal analytic values, not as paper claims.
per_pulse_hardware_overhead.paper_facing_rule: Never quote a sub-microsecond gate time as the paper number. If T_ideal + rise/fall lands below 1 microsecond, either quote "< 1 us, overhead-limited" or defer the absolute headline until per-pulse overhead is measured.

meth_c_rot_time_model.general_C_ROT_structure: control mapping = B(pi, 0) and B(-pi, 0), 2*t_pi FIXED; target sequence = B(pi, 0), B(theta, phi), B(-pi, 0), contributing 2*t_pi + t(theta). Total = 4*t_pi + t(theta).
meth_c_rot_time_model.known_input_C_ROT: 1 fixed pi + 1 theta-scaled BSB pulse = t_pi + t(theta) (n_BSB = 2).
meth_c_rot_time_model.convention_note: Under the user-specified formula, Omega_BSB is angular Rabi frequency (rad/s). At Omega_BSB = 2*pi*4 kHz: t_pi = 62.5 us, t(theta) = 19.9*theta us/rad.

choi_arxiv2601.covers: QCR / SDR conditional-Kerr; single off-resonant tone on red sideband
choi_arxiv2601.validates_our_QCR_formula: chi = Omega_sb^2/(4 delta) = eta^2 Omega_c^2/(4 delta) — algebraically identical to Choi; predictions match within ~2 sigma at both delta values.
choi_arxiv2601.ac_stark_cancellation: two-segment sequence split by microwave pi pulse, t1/t2 = delta1/delta2; adds ~2x overhead vs single-segment.

QCR_experimental_anchor.status: experimentally anchored (not theory-only) as of this anchor update
QCR_experimental_anchor.primary_experimental_source: Choi arXiv:2601.04591 (171Yb+); validates chi formula within error
QCR_experimental_anchor.operator_mapping_reference: Paper ISA QCR gate is Pi_l-conditioned: U_QCR(theta,l) = exp(-i theta Pi_l (x) n), Pi_l = |l><l| (only |l> rotates; |g> and any spectators inert; verified at d=3, hypulse_validation/qcr_d3_spectator_audit.json, F=1, spectator phase 0). The Choi SDR / sigma_z / Xi_l form is the HARDWARE INTERMEDIATE (native dispersive light shift is symmetric on {g,l}); the difference between Pi_l = (I - sigma_z)/2 and (-sigma_z/2) is an unconditional mode rotation, absorbed into the free mode frame, so T_QCR = T_CR = theta/chi at bound saturation. Conditional phase per photon differs by 2x between conventions (Pi_l: theta; sigma_z/Xi_l: 2*theta); all paper numbers use the Pi_l convention.
QCR_experimental_anchor.paper_facing_T_QCR_overhead_note: 2 segments at Meth anchor Omega_BSB=4 kHz + microwave pi. t_pi = pi/Omega = 5 us at Omega/2pi = 100 kHz, ASSUMED (Ringbauer-class carrier; Omega not measured in Meth).
QCR_experimental_anchor.no_snap_realization_on_trapped_ions: Confirmed by Liu et al. PRX Quantum 7, 010201 (2026): no direct SNAP on trapped ions due to lack of dispersive coupling; must synthesize from sideband transitions.
QCR_experimental_anchor.hypulse_status: simulation only; no experimental calibration on selected apparatus (hardware_pulse_benchmark_ca40 audit)
